reason: Owner asks for another test while deciding whether to order compatible memory; same-DIMM reseat and captured retest did not improve startup
status: Original two-installed-supply comparison unavailable on reported setup; alternate same-model PSU availability/identity requested, no test performed
requested_information: which currently have power cords connected
prerequisites: Confirm current physical target/state and compatible AC PSU identities
If two suitable AC supplies are present, preserve their physical slot assignments; do not mix with C8375/G2 records
Keep cover, cooling and both PSU modules fitted; leave current DIMM/battery unchanged
Use same AC cord and outlet for both comparisons, with no other AC feed to router
Reconfirm native USB console and exclusive ownership before arming capture; keep RJ45 console unplugged
proposed_sequence: Prepare fresh receive-only native USB capture at 115200/8N1/no flow before power-on, matching prior baseline
With router off, feed first explicitly identified PSU only; record PSU-specific indicators, front LEDs and console bytes through controlled startup
Power off, remove AC feed and wait at least 30 seconds; move the same cord to the other identified PSU, retaining same outlet and other hardware/settings
Record the equivalent second startup, then close capture and compare outcomes
control_note: This compares the powered supply/slot path; both PSU modules remain fitted. It is not complete electrical isolation of a potentially loading unpowered module. No live PSU removal or open-cover powered probing requested.

interpretation.different_outcomes: Supports a supply-specific or slot/power-path issue; does not yet separate PSU from slot
interpretation.both_unchanged: Does not prove all power rails good or diagnose ROMMON corruption; remaining board-rail/reset/clock/firmware faults unresolved
interpretation.one_supply_only: Do not invent a second test; assess a confirmed compatible alternate supply or define qualified board measurements instead

indicator_note: Record individual PSU indicators as well as main LEDs. With one installed PSU deliberately unpowered, the main PWR LED may report a supply/redundancy condition; do not automatically interpret this as a new CPU/boot failure.

original_plan_status: The preceding two-installed-PSU prerequisites/sequence are retained as the initial conditional proposal, not executed instructions for the reported one-supply setup.

replacement_plan.status: Availability and distinct physical PSU identity pending
replacement_plan.candidate: PWR-CC1-250WAC / LIT2852A9TJ, historically used in C8375-A / FDO2742M0FK
replacement_plan.historical_result: Powered successful C8375 automatic 17.15.6 cold boot on October 31; fan cycling and unsupported-model recognition on that G2 platform persisted. This is not a complete PSU electrical health qualification.
replacement_plan.compatibility: Cisco classic C8300-1N1S-4T2X guide explicitly lists PWR-CC1-250WAC; G2 support discrepancy does not imply incompatibility with classic C8300.
required_confirmation: Candidate serial is distinct from the currently installed C8300 supply; same model name does not prove a second physical unit
Donor target/current state before any shutdown or removal
Both affected chassis off and AC disconnected before physical exchange; preserve separate PSU identities
C8300 cover/cooling fitted, PSU latched, DIMM and coin-cell unchanged; fresh console cabling/ownership check before capture
replacement_plan.test: If a distinct available candidate is confirmed, replace the original PSU in the same C8300 slot, retaining same AC cord/outlet and remaining hardware; capture native USB startup at 115200/8N1/no flow and compare indicators/output with prior baseline.
replacement_plan.interpretation: A boot/output improvement would implicate original PSU/contact path; unchanged silence would not validate all internal rails or prove ROMMON corruption.
